Ari (partnerships): Heads-up: Vertex Reseller's PO failed portal validation due to dual-signature format. Customer needs billing turned on tomorrow. :alarm_clock:
Jo (partner-ops): Paste portal error?
Ari (partnerships): Portal: <error code="PO_VALIDATION_FAIL">multi_signer_not_supported</error>
Ari (partnerships): PO snippet: <PO id="VTX-2026"><Vendor>VERTEX-RESELL</Vendor><Signers><S>customer-signer</S><S>reseller-signer</S></Signers></PO>
Sam (finance): If we auto-collapse signers we must not change billingEntity mapping. Check if PO has billingEntity field.
Rae (eng-integrations): Quick mitigation: add transformation in gateway to set EffectiveSigner=customer-signer and add header X-Original-Signers=["customer-signer","reseller-signer"]. Safe and reversible. ~2 days to deploy to staging.
Priya (legal): We need a one-off waiver or a contractual acknowledgement if we change signature metadata. Can we get customer/reseller to sign short consent email for now?
Jo (partner-ops): I'll ask marketplace for an admin override (ticket MK-11001). MarketplaceBot: "MK-11001 created: PO rejected - multi_signer_not_supported. Partner review ETA 48h."
Ari (partnerships): Plan: request admin override for immediate go-live + parallel engineering transform + legal draft acknowledgement. Action owners: Jo -> escalate override; Rae -> prototype transform; Priya -> waiver template; Sam -> verify billingEntity. Follow up in 4 hours.
